## What we do
Creative Clusters helps niche businesses grow with psychology-driven (neuromarketing) campaigns across social media, Meta/Facebook ads, Google ads, local SEO, website design, and commercial / short-form video. The website’s single conversion goal is booking free strategy calls.

## Niches
- Car showrooms / automotive social & video marketing
- Weddings & nikkah
- Universities / enrollment marketing
- Food trucks (DMV)
- Restaurants (videography + social packages)
